notes.title: general update
notes.notes:
We know that the release of our game did not meet expectations — the graphics and gameplay fell short, and we feel that frustration along with you. But we are here to say that this is not the end of the story… it is just the beginning.We are already working on updates that will transform your experience:



🌄 Amazing new scenarios that will expand the game world.

🎮 Significant improvements in gameplay to make it more dynamic and fun.

🛠️ Enhancement in visual quality, with attention to the details that make a difference.

This journey continues with you by our side, and every piece of feedback received is being taken into account. We are building something better, with more care, more passion, and above all, with the commitment to deliver an experience that is worth it.Thank you for believing in the potential of our game. The best is yet to come!
